title: Graveyard's
description: You now will drop a grave at your death site instead of normally dropping your items.
body:
# ☠️ Graveyards 
get rid of the panic of watching your gear scatter across the ground. Graveyards makes a grave spawn exactly where you fell, locking your items away safely until you return to claim them.

Each grave has a floating hologram displaying your name and death location, so your grave is marked and findable easily 

## ⚡ Key Features

- 🪦 Automatic grave spawning on death
- 🔤 Name & info holograms floating above each grave
- ⚙️ Very Lightweight
